svg.title: Find the source of a preference
svg.desc: A reply that happens to suit you does not prove where the preference came from. Limit the input. Use only the fictional preference card. Ask. Request the format named on its Reminder line. Verify. Compare the reply with that line before trusting another inferred preference.
svg.text: Find the source of a preference
A reply that happens to suit you does not prove where the preference came

Request the format named on its Reminder line.
Compare the reply with that line before trusting another inferred preference.
